kpis.description_fr: Revenu Powered Vehicles Group (suspensions OEM véhicules motorisés : pickup trucks, side-by-side, motoneiges). Exposé au cycle pickup truck US.
kpis.description_en: Powered Vehicles Group revenue (OEM suspensions for motorised vehicles: pickup trucks, side-by-side, snowmobiles). Exposed to U.S. pickup truck cycle.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu Specialty Sports Group (suspensions vélo VTT / route haut de gamme, marques FOX, Race Face, Easton, Marzocchi). Cyclique post-boom Covid.
kpis.description_en: Specialty Sports Group revenue (high-end MTB / road bike suspensions, brands FOX, Race Face, Easton, Marzocchi). Cyclical post-Covid boom.

kpis.description_fr: Part du revenu Aftermarket (vente directe aux utilisateurs / dealers, vs OEM). Marge brute supérieure et résilience cycle.
kpis.description_en: Aftermarket revenue share (direct-to-user / dealer, vs OEM). Higher gross margin and cycle resilience.

kpis.description_fr: Contribution Custom Wheel House (CWH) / AAG acquisition Q2 23. Diversification post-cyclical bike & truck.
kpis.description_en: Custom Wheel House (CWH) / AAG acquisition Q2 23 contribution. Diversification post-cyclical bike & truck.

_notes: Fox Factory = leader suspension premium (powered vehicles + bicycles). KPIs spécifiques au mix 3 segments + aftermarket %. Period 2023 = ralentissement post-Covid sur bicycle (Specialty Sports -25%) compensé partiellement par AAG.

kpis_story.description_fr: Intégration de Marucci Sports (acquis fin 2023, ~575 M $) : diversification au-delà du segment OEM moto/auto, baseball équipement premium.
kpis_story.description_en: Marucci Sports integration (acquired late 2023, ~$575M): diversification beyond OEM moto/auto, premium baseball equipment.
